description: The standing-ticket shape (FRIC-1781280001, ADR-0551 hardening): a sign-off door entry lingers for a key that exists NOWHERE — not in the merge-base frozen face (the debt it admitted is gone or was never there), not in current, not in proposed. Door entries never mechanically expired, so a stale entry was a permanent admission ticket: re-introducing that exact debt key would be laundered past BOTH predicates (signed_off in compare-mode, exempt from ratchet growth). The inert-entry detector flags it RED with the remediation: retire the entry (move it to _sign_off_retirements). No code fails compare-mode and there is no growth — the inert entry ALONE flips the verdict.
